from pathlib import Path

MANUAL_ROOT = Path("/srv/synthetic/manuals")


def open_manual(requested):
    root = MANUAL_ROOT.resolve()
    candidate = (root / requested).resolve()
    candidate.relative_to(root)
    return candidate.read_bytes()
